definitions.explanation: a small flat piece used to pluck or strum stringed instruments

examples.japanese: ピック⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
examples.english: To play guitar with a pick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ピック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弾|ひ}き→弾く：02444_hiku⟧やすい。
examples.english: A thin pick is easier to play with.

examples.japanese: ピック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To adjust the position of holding the pick.

notes:
From English "pick." In Japanese, ピック almost exclusively refers to a guitar pick (plectrum). The broader English senses of "pick" are expressed differently in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピック⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧: to play with a pick
- ピック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold a pick
- ピック{弾|び}き: pick-style playing

TYPES BY MATERIAL:
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧ (plastic) — most common
- べっ{甲|こう} (tortoiseshell) — traditional
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧ (metal)

TYPES BY THICKNESS:
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (thin) — flexible, good for strumming
- ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) — rigid, good for single-note picking

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ピック: finger pick
- フィンガーピッキング: fingerpicking (playing without a pick)
